name: zelseptik-frontend-workspace
description: Design System v2 frontend workspace for ЗЕЛСЕПТИК / HostCMS

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:css: npm run build:runtime && npm run build:app && npm run build:critical && npm run build:style
scripts.build:critical: sass src/scss/critical.scss dist/css/critical-app.min.css --style=compressed --no-source-map && node scripts/build-critical-css.mjs && sass dist/css/critical.css dist/css/critical.min.css --style=compressed --no-source-map
scripts.build:dev: npm run build:css:dev && npm run build:js
scripts.lint: npm run lint:scss && npm run lint:js
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:scss -- --fix && npm run lint:js -- --fix
